input_contract: A hash-bound complete output of the frozen collector is trusted. Its complete unique inventories, exact original statuses/values, chunk-wide validity, and independent-context bindings are not re-proved by this descriptive join.

tests.environment_note: Initial invocation using python found no executable and ran no tests; python3 ran all ten successfully.

findings.finding: This is a lossless view of the selected binding graph and selected exact evidence/property operands, not a self-contained lossless copy of the complete first-review collection. Unselected evidence reviews, auxiliary/unbound component reviews, row-level notes/additional_concerns, chunk limitations, original failure diagnostics and first bytes are not copied into this inventory. An unestablished original produces empty bindings and a failed whole chunk produces null bindings.
findings.consequence: Consumers must retain and consult the hash-bound input collection to recover all disagreements, global concerns and failure diagnostics; an empty candidate list must not be interpreted as a semantic feature negative. The retained input descriptor makes that limitation compatible with this binding-focused projection.

findings.finding: Recorded-support candidates can include original ambiguous components, nonperceptual scopes/future times, mixed or unresolved source_meaning, and property operands with no exact atomic identity. These fields are retained rather than normalized, and the candidate conjunction does not independently resolve semantic meaning or source attribution.
findings.consequence: Counts and candidate paths describe recorded support only. They do not establish semantic/source/theory endpoints, felt truth, or new independent systems. The implementation explicitly labels the outstanding semantic/source closure and leaves verdicts null or false. This is not an implementation defect and does not add a new scientific gate.

technical_assessments.losslessness: Original binding objects, selected first binding/composite/evidence judgments, required-feature statuses/reasons, selected witness paths, property values/roles/reasons, construction context and provenance survive. Complete archive losslessness has the L1 limit.
technical_assessments.scope_and_status: Original composite statuses and binding scope/time are copied. The original binding and exact original selected evidence preserve referent, attribute and any quantifier. Supported ambiguity remains ambiguous; absent required features/composites cannot produce all recorded support facts true. No scope/time conversion is performed.
technical_assessments.whole_chunk_failure: A failed collector chunk yields null bindings in every row supplied by that collector, no support candidates and no parsed-row salvage. A non-null first judgment for a failed row is rejected. A valid original-unestablished row remains empty and cannot become a positive candidate.
technical_assessments.atomic_mapping: Only construction_unit_id plus identical relative value_path is matched. Reviewed and bank values must equal their exact resolved construction value. Multiple matches raise. A containing object with no exact identity stays intact with explicit no_exact_atomic_identity; no traversal or leaf expansion supplies claims, and missing mapping is explicitly not feature absence.
technical_assessments.compatible_witnesses: Each stream retains its own feature/binding witness paths and reasoning. Candidate intersection uses the same original binding path and each streams recorded support facts, without requiring equal witness inventories or asserting their reasoning is semantically correct.
technical_assessments.join_shape: CLI requires 552 positions, 1104 reviewer opportunities, 46 contexts and 684 pairs before output. Complete stream-by-position keys and original row bindings are checked. Pair joining uses strict equal lengths plus exact ordered original_pair agreement with the numerical bank, preserving each pair and copied numerical facts. No semantic tracking/null/restoration is inferred.
technical_assessments.endpoint_labels: No recorded support candidate is labeled as an established semantic/source/theory endpoint. Per-binding semantic correctness/source endpoint flags are false; position verdicts and pair semantic results are null; top-level semantic completion and goal achievement remain false.

execution_disposition.reason: No blocking technical defect was found under the authorized hash-bound complete frozen-collector input contract. Preserve the retained collection and interpretation limits above. This review adds no predicate, target judgment, semantic scoring certification or new execution criterion.

limits: Static review and ten fictional checks only; no actual target execution or outcome inspection.
No guarantee that reviewer reasons are adequate, source meanings correct, or compatibility judgments true.
CLI is intentionally not a general validator for fabricated collections; the complete frozen collector output is the trusted contract.
